inclusions.text: Pickup from your Cairo or Giza hotel
inclusions.source: The tour runs six to eight hours and begins with a pickup from your Cairo or Giza hotel.
An English-speaking Egyptologist guide accompanies you throughout; this is a private tour, so the pace and the questions are yours to set.

inclusions.text: Transport back to your hotel in Cairo
inclusions.source: After a day filled with discovery, relax as we transport you back to your hotel in Cairo, leaving you enriched with the knowledge and sights of ancient Egyptian civilization.
